title: Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity with a Shrinking Donut and Vanishing First-Stage Strength
banked_reason: D0.5 general referee: tier=incremental; meets_floor=false; paper_score_ceiling=5.4<7.4; salvageable=false. The finite-critical minimax values and attaining procedures remain open.
gap_reasons: The advertised full finite-critical sharp risk and honest-diameter frontier is replaced by two-point brackets and trivial universal upper bounds; exact values and uniformly attaining procedures are explicitly still open.
The promised matched-information comparison with residual AR presently yields only L_n^res >= L_n; neither a critical limit nor strictness/equality is delivered.

The theorem correctly blocks transport to binary-treatment fuzzy RD for the declared class, so the delivered result must be positioned as a Gaussian benchmark rather than as the promised causal-data frontier unless a narrower causal class and directed comparison are supplied.
proof_attempt_summary: The D0 derivation established the exact donut-dominated Gaussian risk and randomized expected-diameter limit, critical-regime recovery and two-point brackets, residual-AR honesty, and an obstruction to global binary-treatment transport; the mathematical referee passed these results. The full finite-critical randomized minimax values and attaining procedures remained open, as did the matched-information AR value. The D0.5 general referee rated the delivered package incremental with paper-score ceiling 5.4 below the field threshold 7.4, and an independent validity check found no bounded same-topic repair.
tldr: This project studies a known-variance two-channel Gaussian jump ratio observed on a fixed grid with a shrinking missing neighborhood. The denominator jump is bounded below by an externally certified sequence, and the current observations do not certify that floor. The proved core gives coupled numerator--denominator recovery with sign-dependent least-favorable strength, an exact donut-dominated limit, and computable finite-critical brackets. Exact finite-critical values and the matched-information comparison with bias-aware residual AR remain open. This is a Gaussian benchmark, not an established binary-treatment Wald or local average treatment effect result.
gap: The inspected weak-FRD, discrete-RD, optimized-RD, weak-IV, and restricted-parameter sources do not determine the full fixed-design two-channel curvature-restricted bounded-ratio minimax absolute risk or honest interval expected-diameter frontier with a shrinking donut and a certified vanishing strength floor.
fill: Derive the coupled testing limit, certify the finite-critical unrestricted decision values, compare NoackRothe2024BiasAware-style residual AR and ImbensWager2019Optimized-style fuzzy ratios with that benchmark at matched information, and quantify the irreducible large-donut loss behind NoackRothe2026Donut. Binary-treatment transfer remains a separate embedding question.
